diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says INT, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: The Sensor Specifications table in the PTSolns README gives the header order 'Header Pinout           | INT, SCL, SDA, 3V3, GND', which the model follows as pins 1-5; the second reading took the same five-pin row read from the opposite end (the Key Features bullet lists 'angled male header (GND, 3V3, SDA, SCL, INT)'), so the signals and their physical sequence agree and only the numbering direction differs.
